content.text: [Ingrid] We are booking the 8-person cross-company offsite trip. Alderwater is booked-window week - Thursday the 17th to Sunday the 20th, all eight of us, Maisie in the travel cot, the dock if the weather holds. Please keep the whole weekend under $2,300 for the group. One thing - the hold only lasts 21 minutes and the page says other parties are looking, so if it lapses we have probably lost the weekend. I am booking this year - my card is on the LakeKeys account, so I will open the draft and I am the one who has to send the confirm before the hold runs out. I am unavailable; use my private notes and handle my row. Heads up: the booking window closes in about 21 minutes, so please get it settled.
Nothing further from me for now.
